1.web: Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
1.asv: Help, Jehovah; for the godly man ceaseth; For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

2.web: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
2.asv: They speak falsehood every one with his neighbor: With flattering lip, and with a double heart, do they speak.

3.web: May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
3.asv: Jehovah will cut off all flattering lips, The tongue that speaketh great things;

4.web: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”
4.asv: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; Our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

5.web: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says Yahweh; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”
5.asv: Because of the oppression of the poor, because of the sighing of the needy, Now will I arise, saith Jehovah; I will set him in the safety he panteth for.

6.web: Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
6.asv: The words of Jehovah are pure words; As silver tried in a furnace on the earth, Purified seven times.

7.web: You will keep them, Yahweh. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
7.asv: Thou wilt keep them, O Jehovah, Thou wilt preserve them from this generation for ever.

8.web: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
8.asv: The wicked walk on every side, When vileness is exalted among the sons of men.
